title: How Does This Company Make Money?
purpose: Build business literacy before procurement terminology.
situation: A customer order worth €84,000 looks like revenue in Sales. The learner must trace what has to happen, what Novaris must spend, and what could destroy margin before treating revenue as value.

truth.key_tradeoff: Paying €3,100 premium freight may protect the €84,000 customer commitment and contribution; refusing the cost may create a larger delivery/margin risk.

strong_reasoning: Revenue is not profit. Procurement decisions must be understood in the context of customer commitments, total cost, continuity and margin rather than unit price alone.
